items.stem: An analyst's firm acted as lead underwriter for an issuer three weeks ago. The analyst wants to publish an initiation now. What does the research rule framework most directly require the analyst to consider?

options.text: Whether a quiet period restricts publishing research around the offering
options.rationale: Correct: offering-related quiet periods restrict the timing of research after a firm participates in an offering.

options.text: Whether the issuer approves the rating first
options.rationale: Issuers cannot approve research ratings; that would breach independence.

options.text: Whether banking will meet its revenue target
options.rationale: Banking revenue is irrelevant to the analyst's regulatory obligations.

options.text: Nothing, because initiations are always permitted
options.rationale: Initiations are not unconditionally permitted; timing restrictions can apply.

items.explanation: Correct: offering-related quiet periods restrict the timing of research after a firm participates in an offering.

items.stem: Which item must appear in a research report when the analyst's firm has an investment-banking relationship with the covered issuer?

options.text: A disclosure of the banking relationship and any resulting conflict
options.rationale: Correct: material conflicts such as banking relationships must be disclosed in the report.
Personal contact details are not a required conflict disclosure.
No rule requires a guaranteed target; that would be misleading.
Confidential issuer governance documents are not a report disclosure item.

items.explanation: Correct: material conflicts such as banking relationships must be disclosed in the report.

items.stem: Banking and the covered issuer both pressure an analyst to upgrade a cautious rating before an offering. Which TWO actions are consistent with research-analyst independence rules? (Select TWO)

options.text: Keep the rating supported by the analysis and document the basis
options.rationale: Correct: ratings must reflect the analyst's genuine, evidence-based view.

options.text: Ensure all required conflict disclosures appear in the report
options.rationale: Correct: disclosure of conflicts is central to compliance.

options.text: Let banking approve the rating before publication
options.rationale: Banking cannot control or pre-approve research ratings.

options.text: Raise the rating to protect the banking fee
options.rationale: Changing a view for banking revenue violates independence rules.

options.text: Promise the issuer favourable coverage for continued access
options.rationale: Trading coverage for access is prohibited.

items.explanation: Correct: ratings must reflect the analyst's genuine, evidence-based view. Correct: disclosure of conflicts is central to compliance.
